name: Interleaved Data Distribution
definition: A data distribution strategy for shared-memory MIMD architectures that distributes pages of the voxel array in round-robin fashion among local memories to avoid hot spotting.
summary: Interleaved Data Distribution is a memory layout strategy that distributes voxel pages round-robin among local memories to prevent hot spotting, differing from other methods by using simple linearized arrays rather than coordinate-based skewing.
